_note: New actor, first pricing entry. PAY_PER_EVENT, two tiers like workday-jobs-scraper: a job with its full description, and one without. Market: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api $0.012/job + $0.01/run with 1,532 monthly users; jobo.world and memo23 $0.004/job. This matches the $0.004 tier with no start fee. No per-run free allowance: buyers schedule searches with onlyNew. A run with no jobs is free. No proxy.

job_row.eventDescription: One job from a company's career site (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee or Personio) with company, title, location, remote flag, posted date, full description, salary where stated, and apply link. A run that returns no jobs is free.

job_row_basic.eventDescription: One job with the same fields but no description (Full description off, or the posting's detail could not be read).
